usages.explain: This structure is also used when presenting more than one reason or cause. 「それで」 is a conjunction used to connect the part before it, which talks about something, with the part after it, which explains the reason or cause leading to that.

examples.content: 今日は雪だし、お金もないし、(それで)出かけません。
examples.transcription: きょうはゆきだし、おかねもないし、(それで)でかけません。
examples.mean: It's snowing today, and I don't have any money, so I won't go out.

examples.content: その中国レストランは食べ物もおいしいし、値段も安いし, (それで) 人が多いです。
examples.transcription: そのちゅうごくれすとらんはたべものもおいしいし、ねだんもやすいし,(それで)じんがおおいです。
examples.mean: The food at that Chinese restaurant is delicious, the prices are low, and there are a lot of people.

usages.synopsis: V-る/ V-た/ V-ない/ Na-だ/ A-い + し, V-る/ V-た/ V-ない/ Na-だ/ A-い + し, それで...
